title: Backend regression tests: 7 crop cases + storage + Needs Review
description: New tests/test_damage_pipeline_regression.py: synthetic crops through DamageClassifier + prediction_service covering 7 cases — (1) normal egg, (2) damaged egg, (3) empty image, (4) invalid input (corrupt bytes/wrong type), (5) low-confidence input (prob near threshold -> Needs Review), (6) grayscale image, (7) BGR input (verifies channel handling). Assert prediction records store damage_status, damage_confidence, damage_model_version, review_reason; Needs Review routing intact in grading_service. Existing tests/test_backend_grading.py + tests/test_detector_artifacts.py must stay green.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 crop cases covered: normal, damaged, empty, invalid, low-confidence, grayscale, BGR
damage_status, damage_confidence, damage_model_version, review_reason present in stored prediction
Low-confidence case routes to Needs Review
Grayscale and BGR inputs handled without channel errors
